data.narrative:
MineSense Technologies is a Growth-stage private company in the Climate & Energy sector that has raised $100M+. The sector includes 9 peer companies (1 public, 8 private), including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, though none represent sufficiently tight comparables at identical stage and valuation tier.

Only the stage-progression method is applicable here. Using total raised ($100M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 1.2x step-up multiplier for Growth-stage advancement yields $120M. The peer-median approach cannot be reliably applied due to insufficient narrow-set peers meeting simultaneous filters for stage, adjacency, and valuation tier; nine same-sector comparables exist, but zero meet the three-way screen required for statistical credibility.

The analysis supports a range of $102M to $138M, with a median indication of $120M. This range reflects anchoring to the disclosed capital raised and near-term stage progression, but carries material uncertainty owing to (1) lack of tight-comparable revenue or margin data, (2) absence of same-stage private valuation multiples in the sector, and (3) reliance on a single methodological input. Investors should seek additional color on MineSense's revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and capex requirements before finalizing conviction on valuation within this range.
